explanation: The statement is about TauCeti's own toric-fan objects: `Fan.algebraicRealizationActionChartMap` (a `pullback.map` of `Spec`s of `affineCoordinateRing`s), the fan morphism's `algebraicActionMap`, and `affineToricSchemeActionMap`. Mathlib (commit 22c725c) contains no toric geometry at all: grepping the whole Mathlib tree for `Toric`, `toric`, `toric variety/scheme`, `affineToric...`, `affineCoordinateRing`, `algebraicRealization...`, `characterGrading`/`coaction`, and `PointedCone`/`IsIntegralLattice` inside `AlgebraicGeometry` gives no relevant hits (the only `Fan` in Mathlib is the product cone in `CategoryTheory/Limits/Shapes/Products.lean`; the only `AlgebraicGeometry/Limits.lean` hit uses `Fan.IsLimit.op` for ring products). The conclusion is an equation between composites of TauCeti-defined morphisms of action-domain pullbacks, proved chartwise via `pullback.hom_ext` plus simp lemmas of the library; no single Mathlib declaration states it, and it cannot be derived from one in a line or two. Batteries and Lean core contain nothing of this kind either.
